IMAGE PROMPT
An original young woman with long, straight light
brown hair in braided pigtails wears clear
lilac-tinted glasses. She wears a brown and cream
striped ribbed halter top with a lace-up front and a
small label, paired with a light-wash denim maxi
skirt with a ruffled slit. White socks and brown
suede sneakers with pink laces complete the look.
She carries a brown leather shoulder bag. Her
expression is calm and direct. Soft, even studio
light. Palette of chocolate, cream, and faded denim.
Playful and preppy, in the style of a Y2K lookbook.
